summary.text: Wayne Farrin is a Democratic member of the Maine House of Representatives who has represented District 47 since December 3, 2024 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
His career experience includes working as a real estate broker and owning a general store.

paragraphs.text: Wayne Farrin attended the Southern Maine Vocational Technical College.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on June 9, 2026.
